about_short_description.short_description: Superpowered AI offers API for retrieval augmented generation to connect LLMs to data and get accurate responses with citations.

product.name: API for Retrieval Augmented Generation
product.description: An API that connects large language models (LLMs) to your data, providing accurate responses with citations.

product.name: SuperStack
product.description: A set of proprietary technologies designed to overcome common failure modes in standard RAG pipelines.

product.name: AutoQuery
product.description: A tool that converts poorly posed user inputs into well-formed search queries to enhance retrieval performance.

product.name: Relevant Segment Extraction
product.description: A feature that dynamically retrieves relevant information by allowing variable length context to be provided to the LLM.

product.name: AutoContext
product.description: A tool that automatically injects descriptive document-level context into text chunks and embeddings.

product.name: Knowledge Base Creation
product.description: A service that allows users to create a knowledge base from local files or URLs, supporting various file types including audio files.
